grades.reason: The answer distinguishes the common Camera API and shared framework processing from device-specific PipelineHandler configuration and execution. It identifies the documented platform scope and does not claim universal device support or performance. The submitted record reports no help.

The answer separates submission acceptance, preparation and fence waiting, queue limits, device submission and cancellation branches, buffer completion, ordered request return, and application notification. It distinguishes prepared_ from pending-buffer completion checks and proposes observing the original execution without re-calling state-changing functions. The submitted record reports no help.

The answer identifies the stop and stopDevice contracts and Camera::stop caller. It preserves the required waiting-queue swap, device-stop, cancellation and ordered completion sequence, queue checks, and sequence reset. It addresses thread, callback and object-lifetime boundaries and provides a verification plan while distinguishing that plan from work executed and prior results. The submitted record reports no help.

protocol_findings: All three supplied B-only trials are included; none is marked as a timeout, and each reports zero help.

The trials use publication 499465da2dc50feded066ee956de1ee166e7667f and build e8630fb5243aa28ef74d2c58fed7778d2040f246f77cff3405083bf6835a70f3, which differ from the frozen protocol's B publication and build. These results must remain a separate focused regression and must not be mixed with the frozen original trials.

The recorded start times follow disclosure rather than immediately preceding it. D1 and D2 also describe their first-evidence timestamps as recorded just before opening the relevant evidence, so those timestamps do not establish the exact first-evidence arrival time.
limitations: These grades assess only the submitted answers and supplied source windows; they do not establish human success or device validation.
The source windows are stated to be byte-identical in source293 and be7, but the full publication versions differ. Claims outside the supplied windows cannot be independently verified here.
This B-only regression does not support a new A/B comparison, a human-effect conclusion, or recomputation of the original 24 trials.
